{{Current events|year=2021|month=12|day=25|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]; [[2021 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]
**A [[Suicide bombing|suicide bomber]] blows himself up at a restaurant during [[Christmas]] celebrations in [[Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Beni]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], killing five people and wounding 13 others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59792840 (BBC News)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**[[human rights in Myanmar|Human rights]] groups and media outlets uncover a [[massacre]] of 30 [[civilian]]s in [[Hpruso]], [[Kayah State]], that occurred the day before. Two [[Save the Children]] staff are also reported missing. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/25/asia/myanmar-christmas-attack-kayah-karenni-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Internet censorship in China]]
**The global version of [[video game]] [[digital distribution]] service [[Steam (service)|Steam]] is reportedly blocked in [[China]]. The China-only version of the service, launched in February of this year, remains accessible. [https://www.theverge.com/2021/12/25/22853520/steam-global-china-banned (''The Verge'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Cumbre Vieja eruption]]
**The scientific committee (Pevolca) of the [[Canary Islands]] government declares that the [[Cumbre Vieja]] volcano's eruptions on [[La Palma]] island stopped after 10 days of inactivity. However, the authorities do not consider the emergency situation to be over. [https://www.rtve.es/noticias/20211225/erupcion-volcan-palma-ultima-hora/2244040.shtml (RTVE)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sarawak]]
*****[[Malaysia]] reports its first locally transmitted case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a fully vaccinated 38-year-old Chinese woman from [[Sarawak]] with no international travel history. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2021/12/25/covid-19-watch-62-omicron-variant-cases-detected-in-malaysia-so-far (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
****The [[Drug Controller General of India]] approves the emergency use of the [[Covaxin]] vaccine manufactured by [[Bharat Biotech]] for children between the ages of 12 and 18 years. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/bharat-biotech-gets-nod-for-emergency-use-of-vaccine-for-children-above-12-years-101640446807900.html  (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Israel]]i [[Government of Israel|government]] finalizes an agreement with [[Pfizer]] to purchase 100,000 courses of the anti-viral drug [[Paxlovid]] for high-risk patients over the age of 12 years, with delivery expected to begin in one week. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-to-receive-100000-pfizer-anti-covid-pills-in-coming-week-report/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkmenistan]]
****[[Turkmenistan]] becomes one of the first countries to approve the usage of the single-dose [[Sputnik Light]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. The [[Ministry of Health (Turkmenistan)|health ministry]] also purchases 600,000 doses of the two-dose [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/turkmenistan-among-one-of-1st-countries-registering-russian-sputnik-light-vaccine/2457424 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 104,611 new cases of [[COVID-19]], which is also the first time that the country has reported more than 100,000 new cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/coronavirus/2021/12/25/France-breaks-100-000-barrier-for-24-hour-COVID-19-infections- (Al-Arabiya English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 54,762 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 5.62 million. [https://www.ilsole24ore.com/art/coronavirus-ultime-notizie-italia-54762-nuovi-casi-e-144-morti-AE8GDe4 (''Il Sore 24 Ore'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 13,765 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.irishexaminer.com/news/arid-40772889.html (''Irish Examiner'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record 6,288 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-12-25/nsw-records-6288-covid-cases/100724732 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic]]
***The [[Dominican Republic]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dominican-republic-reports-first-case-covid-19-omicron-variant-2021-12-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[James Webb Space Telescope]], [[Ariane flight VA256]]
**The [[James Webb Space Telescope]] is successfully launched using the [[Ariane 5]] rocket from the [[Guiana Space Centre]] in [[Kourou]], [[French Guiana]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/12/25/world/james-webb-space-telescope-launch-scn/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Rail transport in Japan]]
**Asa Coast Railway announces a [[dual-mode vehicle]] that can operate on roads and railways. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1665641 (Dawn Magazine)]
